mapper.select: SELECT id, option_group_id, name, price_change, is_available, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_menu_option WHERE id = #{id} AND is_available = TRUE

SELECT id, option_group_id, name, price_change, is_available, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_menu_option WHERE option_group_id = #{optionGroupId} AND is_available = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT mo.id, mo.option_group_id, mo.name, mo.price_change, mo.is_available, mo.sort_order, mo.created_at, mo.updated_at FROM tb_menu_option mo JOIN tb_menu_option_group mog ON mo.option_group_id = mog.id WHERE mog.menu_id = #{menuId} AND mo.is_available = TRUE ORDER BY mog.sort_order, mo.sort_order, mo.id
SELECT COALESCE(price_change, 0) as price FROM tb_menu_option WHERE id = #{optionId} AND is_available = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_menu_option (option_group_id, name, price_change, is_available, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{optionGroupId}, #{name}, #{priceChange}, #{isAvailable}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_menu_option SET name = #{name}, price_change = #{priceChange}, is_available = #{isAvailable}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tb_menu_option SET is_available = #{status} = 'AVAILABLE', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
